```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 07_sampling_variability
title: >
  Standard error
questions:
  - id: standard_error_n20
    type: numeric
    prompt: >
      For the IQ population with a standard deviation of 15, what is the standard
      error of the mean for samples of size 20? Give your answer to two decimal places.
    hints:
      - >
        You can set the tutorial's slider to $n = 20$ and read the standard error,
        or calculate it using $\sigma_M = \sigma/\sqrt{n}$, with $\sigma = 15$ and $n = 20$.
    answer: 3.35
    tolerance: 0.01
    explanation: >
      $\sigma_M = 15/\sqrt{20} \approx 3.35$. This is the standard deviation of the
      sample means; the standard deviation of individual IQ scores is still 15.
```
